name: Nyarlathoteppppp-pi-jev-context
description: Cache-neutral context trimming for the pi coding agent, powered by TypeSafe Jev: long tool output cut to verbatim key lines before it enters context, with lossless recall. Measured, with pre-registered benchmarks.
